metadata.description: SharePoint site that hosts the five Fleet* lists (Site Address).
OneDrive for Business folder ID of FleetAgent/outbox (from the trigger's folder picker, Code view, or Get file metadata using path).
App ID (GUID) of the FleetAgent canvas app: Apps > ... > Details.
UPN of the operator who receives push notifications.

parameters._comment_unverified: folderId taken from an environment variable instead of the folder picker; the picker stores a folder ID, so the variable must hold that ID. README 'Verify on import' row 3.

When_a_file_is_created_(properties_only)._comment_unverified: splitOn path ('body/value') and the recurrence block: on Microsoft 365 seeded plans the platform enforces a 5-minute floor whatever is written here; confirm in the trigger's Code view. README 'Verify on import' row 4.

inputs._comment_unverified: With Infer Content Type = No the connector returns application/octet-stream, which the runtime carries as {$content-type, $content(base64)}; hence base64ToString. If Parse JSON fails with an 'Expected Object' error, see README 'Verify on import' row 5 for the two alternatives.

definition.description: FleetOutboxToLists: every new *.json under FleetAgent/outbox becomes an upsert into the five Fleet* lists, keyed by Title, plus a content-free push for approvals and non-info notifications. Contract v1.
